{{Quote|Deploy the fleet so that nothing gets off the system.|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], to [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Firmus Piett/Legends|Piett]]|<ref name="ESB" />}}
'''Death Squadron''', known also as ''' Grand Fleet''', was the codename applied to [[Supreme Commander (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Supreme Commander]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] personal [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], led by the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']]. Because of it being led by the ''Executor'', their fleet insignia also bore an image of the ''Executor'' on it. The fleet, designed to instill terror in dissidents of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire's]] [[New Order/Legends|New Order]], was in fact tasked with locating and destroying the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Alliance High Command/Legends|headquarters]]. Moreover, Vader used his fleet in a more personal mission to find and capture his son, [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi training/Legends|trainee]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]].

Though Death Squadron initially consisted of only six ships&mdash;the ''Executor'' and five Star Destroyers&mdash;it earned a fearsome reputation as the personal armada of [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] Vader, who also had the authority to assign additional ships from other sectors as he saw fit.<ref name="EGWp164" /> By the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], Death Squadron had been reinforced to include the ''Executor'', two [[Battlecruiser/Legends|battlecruisers]], three [[Tector-class Star Destroyer|''Tector''-class Star Destroyers]], and thirty-three [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial'' Star Destroyers]].<ref name="EGWp185" />

==Composition==
About half a dozen or so [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]] comprised Death Squadron at any one time, while the [[Supreme Commander (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Supreme Commander]]<ref name="kenner">{{KennerCite|set=Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (toy line)|pack=Darth Vader vs. Prince Xizor|link=soteKxizor-vader.asp}}</ref>, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], or the [[Fleet Admiral/Legends|fleet's admiral]] could reassign ships from other fleets to Death Squadron whenever needed. Likewise, ships assigned to the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord's]] [[Fleet/Legends|armada]] could be sent off from the main fleet on reconnaissance missions when deemed appropriate.<ref name="Fact File 4">{{FactFile|4|HOT 1-6|The Battle of Hoth}}</ref>

The centerpiece of Death Squadron was [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] Vader's [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']], while a number of smaller vessels routinely acted as support ships. Together, Death Squadron was the most powerful assemblage of [[Warship/Legends|warships]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] history.<ref name="BTM">''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]''</ref><ref name="GG3">[[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back'', Second Edition]]</ref>

Famed units attached to the fleet included [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Soontir Fel/Legends|Soontir Fel's]] [[181st Imperial Fighter Wing/Legends|181st Imperial Fighter Wing]],<ref name="The Making of Baron Fel">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 25|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 25]]</ref> [[Major General]] [[Maximilian Veers/Legends|Maximilian Veers]]' [[Blizzard Force/Legends|Blizzard Force]],<ref name="GG3" /> the [[Scimitar Squadron (Imperial)/Legends|Scimitar]] [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bomber]] squadron,<ref name="Death Star II Limited">{{CCG|set=Death Star II Limited|cardname=Scimitar Squadron TIE}}</ref> the [[Obsidian Squadron/Legends|Obsidian]] [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighter]] squadron,<ref name="Cloud City Limited">{{CCG|set=Cloud City Limited|cardname=Obsidian 8}}</ref> and elements of [[Stormtrooper Commander/Legends|Stormtrooper Commander]] [[Bow (clone stormtrooper)|Bow's]] [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]].<ref name="O66">{{InsiderCite|87|Order 66: Destroy All Jedi}}</ref>

===Ships===
[[File:Griffattack.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Death Squadron's Star Destroyers [[Yavin blockade|blockading]] [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].]]
Death Squadron's permanent establishment consisted of the [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] ''Executor'' and five standard [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]] (the [[Avenger/Legends|''Avenger'']], ''[[Stalker/Legends|Stalker]]'', [[Conquest (Imperial-class)/Legends|''Conquest'']], [[Rebel Dream|''Tyrant'']], and [[Devastator/Legends|''Devastator'']]), though [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Vader had authority to temporarily attach other fleets' ships when it was necessary.<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref><ref name="TEGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> During the [[Yavin blockade|Blockade of Yavin]], the [[Emancipator|''Accuser'']] had been part of Death Squadron's temporary line of ships.<ref name="TNEGtC">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> During the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], Death Squadron included the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyers]] ''[[Avarice]]'' (which was destroyed by [[X2]] of Grey Squadron)<ref name="Elite Squadron">''[[Star Wars Battlefront: Elite Squadron]]''</ref> and [[Corrupter (Imperial-class)|''Corrupter'']],<ref name="Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]''</ref> the ''Victory''-class Star Destroyer ''[[Firewind]]''<ref name="AWTC">{{JournalCite|2|A World to Conquer}}</ref> as well as at least [[Unidentified Imperial-class Star Destroyer (asteroid collision)|one]] ''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer that ended up obliterated during Death Squadron's pursuit of the ''Millennium Falcon'' in the [[Hoth asteroid field/Legends|Hoth asteroid field]],<ref name="ESB" /> and at least one ''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer that ended up damaged during the fighting on Hoth.<ref name="Rebel Strike">''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron III: Rebel Strike]]''</ref>

As of the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the squadron had swelled to include dozens of capital ships, which included the Battlecruisers ''[[Ilthmar's Fist]]'' and [[Pride of Tarlandia/Legends|''Pride of Tarlandia'']] (the latter of which acted as the ''Executor''{{'s}} second in command), as well as the [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'']], the ''[[Thunderflare]]'', the ''Accuser'',<ref name="TNEGtC" /> ''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer Adjudicator (which had previously served Death Squadron in the Battle of Poln System),<ref name="BTM" /> the ''[[Death's Head]]'', the [[Stormhawk (Imperial I-class)|''Stormhawk'']], the ''[[Nemesis]]'', the [[Inexorable (Imperial I-class)|''Inexorable'']], the [[Relentless (Dorja)|''Relentless'']],<ref name="TEGTW" /> and at least 20 other ''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers, as well as 3 ''Tector''-class Star Destroyers.<ref name="EGWp185" />

==History==
{{Quote|General, there's a fleet of Star Destroyers coming out of hyperspace in Sector Four.|[[Romas Navander/Legends|Romas Navander]], during the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]|<ref name="ESB" />}}
===Hunting the Alliance===
[[File:DeathSquadronQeimatHoth-TEA.png|thumb|right|250px|The Death Squadron traveled from the Qeimet system to Hoth when Echo Base was discovered there.]]
After Lord [[Ars Dangor/Legends|Ars Dangor's]] announcement,<ref name="Imperial Sourcebook2">''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]''</ref> concerning Lord Vader's consolidated Supreme Commander powers,<ref name="kenner" /> the latter formed Death Squadron to strike back at the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] for the defeat at the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. For three years, Death Squadron hunted the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Rebel Fleet]] from system to system under the command of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Kendal Ozzel/Legends|Kendal Ozzel]], mercilessly crushing any [[Alliance Military/Legends|insurgent forces]] it encountered. At some point during this time, it rendevouzed with a fleet of [[Allegiance-class battlecruiser|''Allegiance''-class battlecruisers]], [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]], [[Procursator-class Star Destroyer|''Procursator''-class Star Destroyers]], [[Bellator-class dreadnought/Legends|''Bellator''-class dreadnoughts]], and various squadrons of [[TIE Advanced x1/Legends|TIE Advanced x1]] starfighters,<ref name="TEGTW" /> the x1s being present among the fleet due to the fleet in question being a high-mobility fleet.<ref name="Hsiao's explanation for the presence of x1s in the picture">As for the X1s, the reason I used those fighters is I imagined that strategic forces would have high mobility, thus requiring hyperdrive capable fighters. Such units would also have the priority necessary to access limited-production run craft. Limited production for a galaxy-spanning military could end up being quite a lot. A much more prosaic reason is that at the time the image was made, I didn't have any hyperdrive-capable fighter models completed except for the X1. (sic)<br />

Ansel</ref> Eventually, a [[Viper probe droid/Legends|probe droid]] launched by the ''[[Stalker/Legends|Stalker]]'' succeeded in locating the Rebel Alliance base of operations on the ice world of [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]].<ref name="ESB" />

After participating in the space and ground [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|battles at Hoth]], Death Squadron pursued the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], which was lost in the Hoth asteroid belt.<ref name="ESB" /> The squadron also lost at least two of its Star Destroyers, including one ''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer, to asteroid collisions during their pursuit of the ''Millennium Falcon''.

===Battle of Endor and fragmentation===
[[File:Avenger-ROTJ.png|thumb|left|250px|The Star Destroyers ''Avenger'', ''Adjudicator'', and ''Stalker'' of Death Squadron in defensive orbit of the second Death Star over Endor.]]
One year later, Death Squadron, under the command of Admiral [[Firmus Piett/Legends|Firmus Piett]], served as the core of the Imperial fleet at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], its ranks having swelled to include dozens of Star Destroyers.<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref> It also gained a second-in-command flagship in the form of the battlecruiser/support vessel [[Pride of Tarlandia/Legends|''Pride of Tarlandia'']]. During the battle, the flagship ''Executor'' was destroyed by a Rebel starfighter crashing into the bridge which left the ship disabled. Being disabled the ''Executor'' then descended and exploded on the Death Star. The battlecruiser ''Pride of Tarlandia'' and sixteen Star Destroyers were destroyed as well.<ref name="EGWp185" />

With the two lead ships of the squadron destroyed, leadership fell to the commanding officer of the [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'']], [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]]. When the [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star]] was destroyed shortly thereafter, and the assumed deaths of both [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] and Lord Vader were apparent, Captain Pellaeon ordered a retreat to the [[Moddell sector/Legends|Moddell sector]] capital [[Annaj/Legends|Annaj]].<ref name="EGWp185" />

Upon arrival, Captain Pellaeon was relieved of command by superior officer [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Adye Prittick]] and a summit of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy's]] surviving members was convened to determine their next move. Dissension resulted in the fracturing of the unit, with some taking their ships and going their own way, while the Death Squadron title officially remained with Prittick and a mere dozen Star Destroyers. The admiral ordered the remnants of Death Squadron to withdraw once more to [[Yag'Dhul/Legends|Yag'Dhul]].<ref name="EGWp185" />

===The Thrawn campaign===
The twelve Star Destroyers and their support lines remaining in Death Squadron were among the few naval assets that remained truly loyal to the Empire after it fragmented into various [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] fiefdoms after the deaths of the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] and his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|enforcer]]. Indeed, despite being accepted as the new Supreme Commander by the [[Imperial Ruling Council/Legends|Imperial Ruling Council]]-in-exile after his return to [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] in [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], Death Squadron was the only force truly available to [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] at the onset of his [[Thrawn campaign|final campaign]] against the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Despite being nominally unified by the Grand Admiral, the Ruling Council and the [[Moff/Legends|Moffs]] hoarded military assets as much in fear of each other as the New Republic.<ref name="TEGTW" />

Of the twelve Star Destroyers remaining in Death Squadron, the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] judged only six - the [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'']], the [[Judicator/Legends|''Judicator'']], the ''[[Death's Head]]'', the [[Stormhawk (Imperial I-class)|''Stormhawk'']], the ''[[Nemesis]]'' and the [[Inexorable (Imperial I-class)|''Inexorable'']] - fully reliable. Grand Admiral Thrawn split the squadron into two fleets: [[Thrawn's fleet (Galactic Empire)|the fleet of six Loyalist Star Destroyers]] led by the ''Chimaera'' under his personal command, and a second force of six ships led by Captain [[Dorja]] aboard the [[Relentless (Dorja)|''Relentless'']].<ref name="TEGTW" />

Of the ships remaining in Death Squadron at the start of the Thrawn campaign, only the ''Chimaera'' and the ''Relentless'' were known to still be active by the signing of the [[Pellaeon–Gavrisom Treaty|Bastion Accords]].
